name: EU CSDDD
full_name: EU Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive
phased_application: Applies to all suppliers of EU companies above EUR 450M revenue. Phase 1 from 28 Jun 2027 (>5000 employees + EUR 1.5B turnover); the >1000 employees + EUR 450M tier follows in the subsequent phase.

rules.requirement: Integrate due diligence into company policies and risk management systems, supported by a code of conduct developed with affected stakeholders.
rules.recommendation: Adopt a board-level due diligence policy and supplier code of conduct.

rules.requirement: Identify and assess actual and potential adverse human rights and environmental impacts in own operations and the chain of activities.
rules.recommendation: Map tier-1 and tier-2 suppliers and run a human-rights and environmental risk assessment.

rules.requirement: Establish and implement a due diligence policy identifying and preventing human rights and environmental risks in operations and the supply chain. A draft does not satisfy the directive.
rules.recommendation: Finalise, board-approve and publish a supply chain due diligence policy covering all tier-1 suppliers before the CSDDD Phase 1 deadline.

rules.requirement: Take appropriate measures to prevent and mitigate adverse impacts, including periodic supplier audits verifying that identified potential and actual adverse impacts are being addressed.
rules.recommendation: Commission SMETA or BSCI audits for the top suppliers by raw material spend.

rules.requirement: Establish and maintain a fair, accessible, predictable and transparent complaints procedure, protecting complainants from retaliation.
rules.recommendation: Implement a formal written grievance mechanism per ILO guidelines and appoint a grievance officer.
